overview_description.description: Edlyft is building software that companies like Google, Dropbox, and LinkedIn use to offer job training programs to college CS students. Companies pay per trainee and use Edlyft's platform to both up-skill and screen for talented future employees. Edlyft is powering the modern way in which candidates will funnel into in-demand roles at every Fortune 500 company through apprenticeship and training.
